title: Mirabel and the Cellar
author: Lena Delacroix
blurb: Orsen Blackwood, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
